The BEAM holds the old code in memory, so a fresh
does nothing until the process is replaced. This is baked into Deploy — the
hook ends in a restart, and
does the same. The restart is also where the 60–90s cold-boot window lives, while deps recompile and the supervision tree (including the Oban Worker runtime) comes back up.

The service hosts the whole BEAM: Phoenix API, the Oban Worker queues, and the embedded Indx Engine. Because LiveView Studio is rendered inside the Phoenix app, it is served by this same unit — restarting the service is what drops and re-establishes Studio's LiveView socket. A wrong
